title.narrative: Support to peaceful co-existence in Yemen
Unterstützung der friedlichen Koexistenz im Jemen

description.narrative: Der Friedensprozess in Jemen ist gestärkt.

The ongoing war in Yemen has worsened the situation of women, young people and civil society actors. For them, opportunities for participation in society are few. Whilst being a much needed force for peace in the country, they are also affected by multiple forms of violence. To realize the peace-building potential of women, young people and civil society actors, they need support and spaces for the exchange of experiences. This way, inclusive and conflict-reducing measures can be implemented more effectively
Women, young people and civil society actors play an active role in shaping peaceful coexistence in their communities.
In line with the German Cooperation’s Whole of Yemen approach, project activities are carried out throughout all of Yemen, targeting groups affected by multiple forms of discrimination. The measures address three interlinked fields of Activity:
1. Supporting women: the project supports women in conflict situations and facilitates various exchange formats to promote networking between women and women’s organizations. 2. Supporting young people: using innovative approaches and digital methods, the project raises awareness of peaceful coexistence among young people in Yemen whilst improving their media information literacy skills. The project develops serious game apps for mobile devices and promotes creative contributions from young people. 3. Capacity building of civil society actors: actors of the civil society receive support in building institutional, technical and methodological skills, enabling them to better implement specific measures to reach their target groups. Together with Deutsche Welle Akademie, the project also strengthens the media and information skills of young Yemeni media professionals and enhances their journalistic skills.

condition.narrative: Conditions - Technical Cooperation is provided free of charge to the partner country; onlending by the partner country government to the project-executing agency as a loan (splitting of terms) is generally not foreseen. Financially strong partner countries are to contribute visibly more to the costs of the development measures in accordance with their capacity.

Konditionen - Die TZ erfolgt gegenüber dem Partnerland unentgeltlich; eine Weiterleitung durch die Regierung des Partnerlandes an den Projektträger als Darlehen (Konditionenspaltung) wird grundsätzlich nicht vorgenommen. Finanzstarke Partnerländer sollen sich entsprechend ihrer Leistungsfähigkeit sichtbar stärker an den Kosten der Entwicklungsmaßnahmen beteiligen
